## Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves

Explain the problem this feature would solve. Is it related to an existing limitation?

## Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed solution or implementation approach.

## Alternatives Considered

List any alternative approaches or features you've considered.

## Impact

How would this feature impact:
- **User Experience:** (how users would interact with this)
- **Performance:** (any performance implications)
- **Architecture:** (any changes to the system design)

## Additional Context

Add any other context or relevant information here.

## Resources

Links to related issues, discussions, or external resources.
